title: lastrea filix-mas var. patentissima
intro: Lastrea filix-mas var. patentissima, commonly known as the Oak Fern, is a variety of the male fern species. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. The Oak Fern has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, ease respiratory issues, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of the Oak Fern include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
